notes: Curated fine-tunable checkpoints, not an exhaustive release archive. Entries with known unsupported TEMPER training workflows are excluded. Backend prerequisites in usage_notes must be satisfied; metadata verification is not a GPU execution test. estimated_num_parameters describes the full pretrained model before downstream adaptation, not checkpoint bytes or optimizer state. Filenames are relative to pretrained_model_dir; weights are not downloaded automatically. See docs/mlff-bundles.md.
